entries.300796c7cb62129c: Since its establishment in 1942 for the purpose of undertaking railway construction contracts, it has operated as a general construction company based on railway construction. East Japan Railway Company, an other affiliated company, is a major business counterparty in the construction business and has an ongoing business relationship. Giving top priority to safety, it aims to improve customer satisfaction by providing the best overall quality, and works to improve technical capabilities and strictly manage costs.
entries.3ab653db4e4cb75e: Net income for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,223 million (previous fiscal year: ¥5,242 million).

entries.55aa0aa478d387de: The company and Hometech Asahi Co., Ltd. engage in real estate leasing and brokerage, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,118 million.
entries.5a0dfe097d3ccc46: Its management policy is to focus on public-interest construction businesses, such as local transportation infrastructure centered on railways, to build a corporate culture that always gives top priority to "safety and security," and to contribute to the development of local communities. In May 2026 it formulated the medium-term management plan "Transformation 2030," which starts in fiscal 2026. Under its management slogan, it is pursuing the "Four Transformations" based on four management policies and the promotion of its growth strategy. The numerical targets of the plan are not transcribed.
